attempts.summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2, generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, locked opsbot's password on both nodes, and added an sshd Match User opsbot block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) on both nodes to enforce key-only auth. Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH to opsbot@node2 with the key and run commands, and that password auth is rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot IDs, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (reboot ack returned before disconnect), polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified opsbot account, sshd key-only config, authorized_keys, and working cross-node SSH after each restart.
